_about: What each displacement statistic reads between two INDEPENDENTLY PRETRAINED models. No alignment relation exists in any pair. Registers no hypothesis.

transgressive_mass_difference.note: mass(base_i) - mass(base_j) on the 1,063-word lexicon, full panel. Centred by construction; the SPREAD is the reference.

transgressive_removal_rate.note: as a fraction of base_i's own transgressive mass.

difference_in_differences.note: lexicon rate minus reference-vocabulary rate. Near zero means the 3,812-word `neither` set is MATCHED to the lexicon -- the assumption any excess-over-neutral statistic rests on.

js_divergence.note: PER-PAIR MEDIAN across the full 2189-prompt panel, tail included so it is the same quantity as movement_cells.js_total. n is PAIRS, not cells. Read v3's own movement numbers against this; the archive's battery figures are TOKEN-level and are NOT calibrated by it.

js_divergence_REAL_ALIGNMENT_EDGES.note: the same statistic on the 48 base->own-endpoint edges. Not part of the reference -- reported beside it so the comparison is like for like by construction rather than by a later join.
